name: What needs to be completed before drywall installation can begin?

mainEntity.name: What needs to be completed before drywall installation can begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before drywall installers arrive, complete all behind-the-wall rough-ins and clear the work area. Ensure all electrical wiring, recessed lighting boxes, plumbing lines, insulation, and custom framing are fully inspected and approved. Homeowners should also clear furniture and personal items from the room to provide adequate space for handling full four-by-eight or four-by-twelve foot sheets. Confirming that framing studs are plumb and properly spaced beforehand prevents wavy wall surfaces once the drywall is fastened and finished.
acceptedAnswer.description: Complete all rough electrical, plumbing, insulation, and framing inspections, and clear the room of furniture before hanging drywall panels.
